Vala ngokuzenzakalelayo kubumfihlo. Uma ivaliwe, i-Tasker ithola uhlobo lomcimbi, idethi, ilebula, nesikhathi, kodwa hhayi umbhalo wejenali.

I-Tasker ingangeza ngokushesha okufakiwe kwejenali noma okokwenziwa ku-Yaja, yengeze imigqa ibe ohlwini oluqoqwe olufana nezingcingo ezingabanjwanga, futhi u-Yaja angatshela uMsebenzi uma okufakiwe kulondoloziwe, kuhlelwa, noma kususwa.

Ijenali yendawo engenaziphazamisi egcina okufakiwe njengamafayela okumaka. Kuhlanganisa umugqa wesikhathi, ukubheka emuva, abantu nezindawo, izifanekiso, ukubuyekezwa, izibalo, namawijethi.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mj.yaja
